0022600237.text: The Lakers, now 11-2 and first in the Pacific and the West, with an 8-2 last ten and a seven-game winning streak, visit the 4-6 Phoenix Suns, who are 11th in the West and 5.5 games back in third in the Pacific. Quentin Grimes is out for the Lakers with a finger injury, while Austin Reaves (heel), Collin Sexton (head), and Luka Doncic (ankle) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions, and Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury that required surgery. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season the Lakers lost the series 2-3, though their most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Los Angeles, ended in a 101-73 Lakers win.
